name: upy-diagram-plugin
description: Workflow plugin phase for generating MicroPython software architecture diagrams from generated firmware and manifest data.

interface.shortDescription: Generates architecture, flow, and data-flow diagrams after firmware generation.
interface.longDescription: Consumes upy-generate-plugin phase_complete manifest_content and generated firmware files, derives docs/diagram.json, validates the diagram schema, renders Markdown, HTML, SVG, and PNG diagram artifacts, then emits a diagram phase_complete with checkpoint, structured errors, and file manifest data without changing the main deploy chain.
defaultPrompt: Run diagram from a generate phase_complete.
Generate architecture diagrams for a MicroPython project.
Validate diagram artifacts and file manifests.
